short: Two stages of kickmix circuit discovery

statements.markdown: so that every basis input stays a single signed basis state
statements.note: A kickmix simulation tracks a bit string and a sign on each sampled branch. If an ancilla holds $f(x)$, an $X$-basis measurement with outcome $m$ contributes the sign $(-1)^{mf(x)}$ on branch $x$. The correction is a function of the retained bits. This makes individual branches cheap to test.

statements.markdown: The result was a circuit of spacetime cost $498{,}168$ ($102$ qubits, $4{,}884$ $T$ gates).
statements.note: The initial restricted search with testing reached $102\cdot4{,}884=498{,}168$. The search using the formal framework then reached $100\cdot4{,}152=415{,}200$ with a circuit still expressible in kickmix. The later $11\%$ improvement is measured from the second of these costs.

statements.markdown: continue optimizing the circuit up to a cost of $415{,}200$
statements.note: The coefficient bits remain Boolean functions of the interval index $s$. Fig. S11(c) evaluates $u_1v_1\oplus u_2v_2$ with interference and six rotations. Two temporary AND computations would cost eight $T$ gates. The final input-dependent sign is cancelled as part of the full lookup pass.
